categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies headers sync logic in src/net_processing.cpp and functional tests in test/functional/p2p_initial_headers_sync.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes an indefinite initial headers sync stall that occurs when an inbound or manual peer replies with empty headers while still syncing. As described in issue #34096, such peers currently retain the active sync slot without being subject to outbound eviction or timeouts, preventing other connected peers with the latest chain from progressing IBD.
